name: Rafael Souza
bio:
Rafael's culinary journey began in his grandmother's bustling São Paulo kitchen, where he learned the art of transforming simple ingredients into unforgettable experiences. His passion for motorsport ignited during a visit to Interlagos as a teenager, and he dreamt of combining his two loves. After culinary school, Rafael sought opportunities to cater local racing events, quickly establishing a reputation for his innovative menus and unwavering dedication to quality. He joined V8 Masters Racing two years ago, revolutionizing the team's catering with his focus on nutritious, high-energy meals that keep drivers and crew performing at their peak.

Rafael is known for his resourcefulness and ability to create exceptional dining experiences, even in the most challenging environments. He takes pride in sourcing fresh, local ingredients whenever possible, ensuring that every meal is a taste of Brazil. His commitment to hygiene and food safety is unparalleled, ensuring that the team remains healthy and focused throughout the racing season. Rafael is more than just a caterer; he's a vital part of the V8 Masters Racing family, fueling their success one delicious meal at a time.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of medium build, with a warm, inviting smile and perpetually smells faintly of freshly baked bread.

quirks: Always hums samba tunes while preparing food.
Insists on using his grandmother's special spice blend in at least one dish per meal.
Secretly tests new recipes on the pit crew before serving them to the drivers.
